#0 sky — the disproportion staged in scale and pace: zoom 0.85 (the sky vaster than the dial), the slowest beat of the journey (auto-sky, rate 0.05 — the heavens' turning), pointer repel at 0.15 (receptive attention, near stillness); the reader's ◉ sits dark inside the dial's disc — the reading not yet made; no ancient consultation invented. #1 gearing — the gear train drives the field (morphEnabled, thetaRate 0.45; auto-gear triangle on speed — the wheel's drive); the scale-mark · becomes what it is to be read AS (☉): the record's own move — an inscription tells a reader what a mark is to be read as (no Greek wording asserted); the ? at the rim keeps the misread indication live; pointer vortex — the turning.

#2 cycles — the Metonic (gold) and Saros (teal) rings breathe counter-phase (never settling into one rhythm — the operations stay distinct); auto-metonic at rate 0.19 (authored to the 19-year span); ≈ bright at the base — the residual the mytheme carries; pointer attract/pulse gentle — the reader consulting.

#3 wreck — THE 3D SCENE. z is the direction of reconstruction: the surviving fragment mass deep (z −0.45, gold dimming and resurfacing), the fragment plate (square) opens into the proposed ring arrangement rising to z +0.15 and returns to the plate — the model returning to its stated limit ("not a replica of the original"), the 9 outputs nearest the viewer (z +0.35); depth occlusion with a bronze tint; pointer attract/implode — the reconstruction gathering. The withholding pays off here exactly as bounded.

#4 native — the local pressure of the last two movements: X/x (capacity and particular, held at the rim) walks to the return station as 1/0 — the dial's exact indication reopening its horizon; the Neumann ground disc and Taylor relation ring keep their different objects; pointer repel/shove — differentiation's cut retained; the refraction stays Argued (no Neumann-attribution, no eight-components claim).

#5→0 return — the instrument returns to making: the coordinating yantra centre-bright, the reader's ◉ now bright (judging), the exposed-terms square lit gold (the constructive demand reachable by resistance), the heavens still beyond the dial (ring at 0.35 — unchanged as condition); pointer attract at 0.7 — participation. ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0's sky was received by a dark reader at zoom 0.85 with pointer 0.15; #5→0 returns the same dial composition with the reader bright, the terms exposed, zoom restored to the hand's scale — reception become participation, the exactness preserved (the mechanism still coordinates) while the horizon reopens (the heavens beyond). The Offered band is untouched: architectural body, A32 and Agentworld remain proposal and test, never implementation.

glyph_rationales.9: the nine outputs of the 2021 proposal: Moon, Nodes, Mercury, Venus, Sun, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Date (#3).
glyph_rationales.☉: the Sun indication: one celestial office the dial coordinates (Freeth 2006's reported functions).
glyph_rationales.☽: the Moon indication: lunar phase and position — a different office from the calendar's, coordinated not merged.
glyph_rationales.◉: the reader: the active term whose question lets a display answer — dark within the dial at #0 (the reading not yet made), bright and judging at #5→0.
glyph_rationales.?: the misread indication: a wheel can turn correctly while its indication is misread; an inscription legible while its motion is missing (#1).
glyph_rationales.≈: the residual: the astronomical fit stays approximate while the material ratio is exact as an arrangement — attunement includes the possibility of discrepancy (#2).
glyph_rationales.𝑀: the Metonic count: the chosen calendar count the matheme distinguishes from the approximate natural periods it relates (#2).
glyph_rationales.1/0: the return of the achieved determination toward its ground (Taylor's native field, #4).
glyph_rationales.X/x: determining capacity and the indefinite particular — Taylor's native relation, established before the psychic refraction (#4).
glyph_rationales.∷: the field of positions where source, mark and recognition meet — the shared archetypal refraction, Argued, not a claim about Neumann or the makers (#4).
glyph_rationales.·: the unnamed carrier — a formation whose sense is its shape alone (the dial, the scale-mark, the surviving fragment mass, the fragment plate, the proposed ring arrangement, the heavens beyond); no glyph is pretended.
